panel_bounds_xyxy.coordinate_convention: 0-based x right/y down in unmodified2835x3705 original; all coordinates here are manual approximate locators, not image measurements.
panel_bounds_xyxy.scope: Main green-filled lower enclosure including its annulated rim. Long exterior bands/loop/stem connections are separately inventoried.

outer_contour.description: Main outline runs as a rounded, irregular rectangle: near-horizontal upper rim, rounded right side, near-horizontal lower rim and indented left side. Most rim has paired brown contours and short hatches. Top, right and bottom can be followed over most of their extents.

unresolved_gaps_or_occlusions.location: Upper-left/left indentation where the long descending band and drawn hand/body contours meet the rim.
unresolved_gaps_or_occlusions.reason: Several contours converge; cannot decide from this native view whether a channel lumen is open into the main field or the exterior band only meets/crosses its rim.

unresolved_gaps_or_occlusions.location: Lower-right curve beside the last lower-row figure and short side protrusion.
unresolved_gaps_or_occlusions.reason: Body/hand outline, annulated boundary and protruding paired lines overlap; a local interrupted or open contour cannot be certified.

unresolved_gaps_or_occlusions.location: Upper rim near the rightmost upper-row head adornments.
unresolved_gaps_or_occlusions.reason: Head/hair strokes touch or overlay the rim in places; not evidence for an opening.

outer_contour.ceiling: Apparent outline continuity is a graphic observation, not proof of a hydraulically closed vessel.

items.location: Between upper and lower rows across the main interior
items.description: A continuous green background band is visible between the rows, with irregular paint and body contours; no independently outlined full-width separating wall can be followed.

items.location: Vertical intervals between successive figures in both rows
items.description: Outline strokes generally trace shoulders, arms, torsos and lower bodies. They do not visibly join opposite rims into separate cells.

items.location: Pale/blue-white curves under the upper row and several lower bodies
items.description: These follow lower-body outlines and painted accents. Their contrast with green does not establish physical compartment walls.

items.location: Upper-left indentation/white wedge beside the first upper-row arm
items.description: A short interior-looking contour/wedge is connected to the crowded rim area; it is not visibly a complete partition, but its exact channel/body/edge relation is unresolved.

items.location: Irregular lighter streaks throughout green field
items.description: No closed independent compartment contour follows these patches.

external_connections.coverage: All visibly distinct main-sheet exterior contour systems associated with the lower enclosure are listed; subdivisions where overlap prevents unique branching are not assigned false graph edges.

items.form: Narrow sinuous band; paired ink edges over substantial portions, green painted stretches and crowded/hatch-like lower strokes.
items.description: Descends from a tapering free-looking upper end left of the paragraph toward the upper-left rim. The approach is definite, but the final open-versus-closed/crossing relation at O1 is unresolved.

items.form: Large broad unpainted exterior loop outlined by two long brown strokes, sweeping below the entire main field.
items.description: The sweep below the panel is visible and paired. Left approach follows the outside of the indented wall; right approach curves upward into the lower-right group of contours. Definite open joins into the green interior are not established.
items.crossing_or_adjacency: The loop and right-side descending strands meet/overlap in a congested area; no uniquely resolved crossing graph is assigned.

items.form: Short side protrusion with paired approximately horizontal outlines and a small rounded green-painted end.
items.description: It abuts the lower-right enclosure region, but its opening/closure is obscured by the nearby figure/rim/loop strokes. It is not assumed to be an inlet or outlet.

items.form: Fine descending, partly paired/wavy strands with elongated loop/leaf-shaped outlines toward the lower-right margin.
items.description: Strands descend from the right protrusion region and overlap or meet the larger lower loop. Which stroke belongs to each connection is unresolved; no flow or direction is assigned.
items.termination: Several lower strokes fade/taper near a green-painted patch; exact terminal closure or continuation is UNKNOWN.

external_connections.count_interpretation: Zero certified open joins in this inventory is a capacity statement, not evidence that every join is closed.

rim_marks.extent: Short brown transverse/slanting strokes occur along most upper, right, bottom and indented-left rim extents; spacing and visibility vary.
rim_marks.other_bundles: Crowded strokes at the upper-left descending-band junction and fine lower-right strands can resemble bundles; branch connectivity remains UNKNOWN.

figure_inventory.method: Manual count of distinct heads and associated torso outlines in the main enclosure; no incidental neighboring-page figures included.

rows.description: Eight head/torso figures in an upper horizontal arrangement. Arms overlap nearby figures or green intervals; one central-left figure has a raised hand.
Eight head/torso figures in a lower horizontal arrangement. Several arms extend toward adjacent figures; contacts do not establish separate compartments.

figure_inventory.count_ceiling: Sixteen visible figures do not establish sixteen physical compartments, ordered process stages or manuscript named entities.

items.location: Short isolated horizontal inscription to the left of the lower enclosure, approximately beside the lower figure row.
items.description: No dedicated leader line or unmistakable label enclosure connects it to one figure, rim segment, band or shared field. Nearby outline convergence does not license nearest-owner attribution.

items.location: Ordinary paragraph ending above the top rim.
items.description: No singular leader from these writing lines to the main enclosure is established. No transcription or semantic ownership attempted.

inscription_placements.other_isolated_writing_in_selected_conne: No additional clearly isolated current-sheet inscription certified in this native view; faint marks/strokes remain unclassified rather than read as words.

direction_markers.unknowns: The taper of C1, rounded green end of C3 and lower-right fine strands are contours/end shapes, not certified direction symbols.
direction_markers.ceiling: No observed marker does not prove no depicted direction; source/destination or actual process direction remains UNKNOWN.

evidence: Common green background is visually continuous around and between both figure rows.
No complete independent internal partition wall or separately enclosed figure cells can be followed.
Main rim appears to delimit one broad field rather than a row of separately ink-bounded units.
disconfirming_or_limiting_features: Upper-left white wedge and crowded junction could conceal a local barrier or open channel.
Figures occlude parts of the interior, so an unseen partition cannot be excluded.
Green continuity is not itself proof of a physically shared medium.
External connection topology and local outer closure remain unresolved.
topology.not_claimed: No material identity, flow, circulation or medical interpretation.
